label: RUCKUS ICX 8200-24FX (16x 1/10G SFP+, 8x 25G SFP28)
description: RUCKUS ICX 8200-24FX stackable 10G fibre switch: 16x 1/10G SFP+ downlink cages, 8x 1/10/25G SFP28 uplink/stacking cages, 720 Gbps switching capacity, no PoE and no copper data ports.

fabric.note: Vendor figure 720 Gbps (data rate, full duplex); forwarding capacity 533 Mpps.

notes: Fibre aggregation member: 16 SFP+ cages in slot 1 (1G or 10G optics) and 8 SFP28 cages in slot 2 (1G, 10G or 25G). No RJ-45 data ports and no PoE - the only copper is the out-of-band management port and the two console ports. 720 Gbps is 16x10G plus 8x25G full duplex, the largest switching capacity in the gigabit/fibre half of the family. Unlike the 24F and 48F (24 and 48 x 1G SFP with four SFP28 uplinks), this model has 10G on every downlink cage. Chassis: single integrated power supply and fans (no redundant PSU), one RJ-45 Ethernet out-of-band management port, one RJ-45 serial console port and one USB Type-C console port, one USB port for external storage. Serial console is fixed at 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit, no flow control; the RJ-45 pinout is pin 3 TXD, pin 6 RXD, pin 4 ground. Boot firmware: 16 MB SPI flash holding two boot images (dual boot), 4 GB DDR4 main memory, 8 GB eMMC NAND. Stacking: up to 12 switches per stack over the SFP28 uplinks (1.2 Tbps aggregate stacking bandwidth; 10 km maximum stacking distance). Layer 3: static routing and RIP in the base image; OSPF, VRRP, VRF, GRE, PIM, PBR, BGP and VXLAN need the ICX8200-PREM-LIC premium licence, so this is modelled as l3-forward with no licence claim. Management: RUCKUS One, SmartZone, or controllerless Unleashed; the box also carries a CLI. Software: FastIron 10.0.20 is the train the ICX 8200 documentation set is published against (FastIron Management Configuration Guide 10.0.20). Sources: ICX 8200 data sheet (PA-117001.3-EN) https://www.ruckusnetworks.com/globalassets/digizuite/993200-RUCKUS-ICX-8200-Switch-Data-Sheet.pdf; ICX 8200 Technical Specifications, part 53-1005761-03, 15 October 2024 https://docs.ruckusnetworks.com/prod/ruckus-pdfs/icx8200-technicalspecification; product page https://www.ruckusnetworks.com/products/ethernet-switches/itemicx8200-24fx/.
